newsitem.title: FRANCE: France seeks 98 deficit close as poss to three pct.
newsitem.headline: France seeks 98 deficit close as poss to three pct.

text.p: Government spokesman Catherine Trautmann said after preliminary 1998 budget talks that France was seeking to get its public deficit as close to three percent of gross domestic product as possible next year.

"What we dealt with during the working session was the main targets in the development of the size of the budget, which will necessarily be very limited due to the fact that we want to set a goal of being as close to three percent as possible," she said.
Trautmann was speaking after a first preliminary meeting of ministers on the 1998 budget to be presented in September.
Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn declined all comment as he left the afternoon meeting.
Strauss-Kahn is due to present his draft 1998 budget to the cabinet on September 24.
